{{Quote|She thought we were too young to go by ourselves. She worries a lot.|Jez, on their mother|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
'''Jez''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Standard day|day]] before Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], Jez went to [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], the sister planet of Alderaan, with his brothers, [[Mazi]] and [[Lan (Human)|Lan]], to watch a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament. Following his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] destruction, Jez and his siblings became [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] to survive on Delaya despite receiving odd jobs from [[Ferus Olin]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. They attempted to rob [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during her [[Mission to Delaya|visit]] to Delaya but were thwarted by Olin, who then threatened to stop giving them work if they continued thieving. The three orphans later decided to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and yearned to tell the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the news.

==Biography==
===Early years===
{{Quote|There was a smashball tournament on Delaya. We got permission to go to the game, stay overnight on our own, then go back to Alderaan in the morning.''"<br />"''But that was the day&mdash;''"<br />"''Yeah. That was the day. So here we are. On our own.|Mazi and Jez, to Han Solo on Alderaan's destruction|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
Jez was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Hostage" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Standard day|day]] before [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], Jez went to see a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament on [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], his homeworld's sister planet, with his brothers, [[Lan (Human)|Lan]] and [[Mazi]]. Despite their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] feeling they were too young to do so, Mazi was able to persuade them, especially their [[Lan's mother|mother]] who worried a lot, to let the brothers stay overnight on Delaya by themselves.<ref name="Hostage" />

[[File:Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alderaan, Jez's homeworld]]
After Alderaan's destruction, Jez and his brothers became orphans and were left to look after themselves, [[Thief/Legends|thieving]] on Delaya to survive. [[Ferus Olin]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and another survivor of Alderaan, tried to dissuade them from turning to a life of crime by giving them various small jobs to earn [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Alderaan made a [[Mission to Delaya|visit]] to Delaya to assist the refugee effort and recruit new members to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Jez, along with Mazi and Lan, attempted to rob her. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], one of Organa's companions, tried to placate the orphans, but the standoff was broken when Olin disarmed Mazi, who was holding Organa at [[Knife/Legends|knifepoint]] with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], by shooting the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] away with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. After Olin threatened that he would stop giving them errands if they continued getting into trouble, Jez and his brothers ran away.<ref name="Hostage" />

===Helping the Alliance===
{{Quote|We're going to be respectful now.|Jez, to Han Solo on joining the Rebel Alliance|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
[[File:HanChillinAtChalmuns-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Han Solo, whom Jez and his brothers looked up to]]
A [[Memorial service on Delaya|memorial]] was held the following day for those who had perished during Alderaan's destruction. Jez and his siblings attended the event but could not get inside the memorial's [[Unidentified chamber (Delaya)|chamber]] due to the large crowd. They were spotted by Solo, who quickly grabbed Mazi into a hold, prompting Jez and Lan to come to their brother's aid. Despite their fear, they stood their ground and demanded that Solo let Mazi go. Impressed by their brave front, Solo released Mazi and befriended the group, offering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and a chance to go inside the chamber. With their guard lowered, Jez and his siblings told Solo how they came to be orphans on Delaya.<ref name="Hostage" />

Jez and his brothers would later speak with a Rebel recruiter and decided to join the Alliance as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Having grown fond of Solo, they eagerly told him the news, hoping to impress him. Solo admitted he was surprised, although he felt Jez and his siblings were too young to serve in the Alliance. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] wished them luck, as they were scheduled to be shipped out that [[Local day/Legends|night]].<ref name="Hostage" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Dialogue|Han Solo|So you're from Alderaan?|Mazi|From nowhere. Not anymore.|Jez|Come on, Mazi, not today.|Mazi|Every day, Jez. You ask me, we're better off forgetting the whole thing ever happened. We are from nowhere. Now.|attr=Han Solo, Mazi, and Jez|src=<ref name="Hostage" />}}
Jez proved to be brave and loyal despite his young age. As a result of Alderaan's destruction, Jez and his brothers became orphans overnight and had to look out for each other. Jez's brother Mazi implemented a rule about speaking in the past tense, to affirm that they were from nowhere and to move on from the tragedy. However, Jez disagreed with the arrangement and complained to his brother about it. When Solo did not turn them in to the authorities for trying to rob Organa, the orphans began yearning to impress the smuggler.<ref name="Hostage" />

When Solo confronted Jez and his brothers on Delaya, Jez refused to leave Mazi, who had been caught in the smuggler's grasp. Solo observed that the boys were terrified of him and putting on a brave front, which earned his grudging admiration. Jez had the quickest temper among the three orphans. When Lan, the youngest of them, teased Jez about not having any respect for him, the older boy was willing to punch him. By the time of his visit to Delaya, Solo surmised that the brothers appeared no more than fifteen [[Standard year|years]] of age.<ref name="Hostage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jez was a character created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]'', the second volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Hostage" />
